releaseNotes:
• Quick Chat Reply & Replace (F10): Fixed text replacement across all outgoing languages (English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, etc.) with native Win32 target window focus restoration.
• Improved Language & Tone Switching: Instant cancellation of previous translation streams without socket errors and automatic focus release on language dropdown.
• LAN Auto-Updater Reliability: Hardened working directory handling and automatic SmartScreen Zone.Identifier unblocking for seamless updates even when originally installed from a LAN network share.
